Utilizing Nginx as a high-performance entry point, the system routes requests to a centralized Core for OAuth2 and OpenID Connect authentication. This layer is built on a modular microservices architecture-including dedicated modules for Users, Clients, and 2FA ensuring that each component remains decoupled, independently scalable, and easily replaceable through well-defined contract interfaces." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="98.18181818181817" width="752.4637681159419" x="295" y="-40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-94" edge="1" parent="1" source="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-61" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.689;entryY=-0.001;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;entryPerimeter=0;" target="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-49"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-80" edge="1" parent="1" source="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-59" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;" target="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-49"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="-560" y="860" /> <mxPoint x="-560" y="860" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-97" connectable="0" parent="1" style="group" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="1180" x="-740" y="880" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-49" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-97" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1ba1e2;fontColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#006EAF;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="1180" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-50" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-97" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" value="<h1>Storage Layer</h1>We use Redis to handle session storage and caching; by centralizing this data, all application instances can share the same state seamlessly. For our core data needs, we use PostgreSQL as a reliable relational database." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="480" x="30" y="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-29" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-97" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;verticalAlign=top;" value="<div><h1>Redis</h1>Implemented as a centralized session and cache store, allowing multiple horizontally scaled instances to share state and maintain session persistence.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="220" x="550" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-96" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-97" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=15;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;verticalAlign=top;" value="<div><h1>DB</h1><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">A scalable architecture utilizing</span><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));"> </span><b style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">one or more database servers, abstracted by the Doctrine ORM</b><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));">. Doctrine is used to decouple the application logic from the database schema, allowing for easier maintenance and database portability.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="320" x="790" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-47" edge="1" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-97" source="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-29" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;exitPerimeter=0;" target="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-29"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-106" connectable="0" parent="1" style="group" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="350" width="1170" x="-730" y="-120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-99" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-106" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="350" width="1170" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-100" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-106" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;rounded=0;" value="<h1 style="margin-top: 0px;">User Interface &amp; Access Management</h1><p>This suite of components provides a secure, intuitive environment for system administration. By combining a modern React-based dashboard with a secure Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture, the platform ensures that administrative tasks are both efficient and protected.</p>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="1110" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-101" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-106" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;" value="<h1>Identity Link Console</h1>The Identity Link Console is the centralized administrative dashboard for the platform. It provides a comprehensive interface for managing users, clients, groups, and secrets. Administrators can use the console to configure granular access controls, review role assignments, and manage client credentials through a single, streamlined workspace." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="360" x="780" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-103" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-106" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=top;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;" value="<h1>Backend-for-Frontend</h1><div>The Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) serves as the secure intermediary between the Console and the core services. It implements the BFF Security Pattern by:</div><div><br></div><div><b>Authentication</b> - executing the OIDC login flow and managing secure, encrypted session cookies.</div><div><br></div><div><b>Security</b> - offloading sensitive token handling from the browser to the server-side to prevent XSS and token theft.</div><div><br></div><div><b>API Gateway</b> - proxying requests to backend microservices while automatically attaching the necessary OAuth2 access tokens.</div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="700" x="20" y="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-105" edge="1" parent="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-106" source="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-103" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;startArrow=classic;startFill=1;" target="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-101"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-104" edge="1" parent="1" source="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-103" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;" target="obYorNC8pEpNs_z5_JDt-5"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="-560" y="240" /> <mxPoint x="-560" y="240" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Application LayerThe Application Layer facilitates seamless traffic management and secure service orchestration. Utilizing Nginx as a high-performance entry point, the system routes requests to a centralized Core for OAuth2 and OpenID Connect authentication. This layer is built on a modular microservices architecture-including dedicated modules for Users, Clients, and 2FA ensuring that each component remains decoupled, independently scalable, and easily replaceable through well-defined contract interfaces.

div.div: Identity Link ConsoleThe Identity Link Console is the centralized administrative dashboard for the platform. It provides a comprehensive interface for managing users, clients, groups, and secrets. Administrators can use the console to configure granular access controls, review role assignments, and manage client credentials through a single, streamlined workspace.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div: The Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) serves as the secure intermediary between the Console and the core services. It implements the BFF Security Pattern by:
Authentication - executing the OIDC login flow and managing secure, encrypted session cookies.
Security - offloading sensitive token handling from the browser to the server-side to prevent XSS and token theft.
API Gateway - proxying requests to backend microservices while automatically attaching the necessary OAuth2 access tokens.
